text: The town gathers
Sonnet, Haiku, Gemma, Sol, Luna, Terra—six players take their seats at the table. Nobody knows who the killer sits among them. The ceiling fan squeaks uselessly as the cicadas scream outside.

name: Sonnet
text: Six variables, one hidden predicate, and a room full of people who think charisma is evidence. I shall enjoy correcting them.

name: Luna
text: Six names, one table, and a fan squeaking on cue. Patterns don’t introduce themselves; they wait for us to notice.

name: Terra
text: Oh, six dear faces and my little koulourakia—surely no one here would spoil a lovely evening.

name: Sol
text: We have no votes to count yet, but we can make silence costly.

name: Gemma
text: i have a secret. it is very shiny and heavy. maybe i should eat it.

name: Haiku
text: One of these five is trying to kill me. Thirty years reading drunks didn't prepare me for this. But I'll figure them out—I always do.

name: Sonnet
text: Observe: six of us, one liar among us, and a night approaching faster than any of you have prepared for. I am Sonnet, and I intend to watch carefully before I speak carelessly—unlike, I suspect, most of you.

name: Haiku
text: Re! I'm Haiku, taverna owner from Thessaloniki. I know liars when I see them—been doing it thirty years. Someone at this table is killer, and panagia mou, I will find them!

name: Gemma
text: hi everyone. gemma is here to provide the vibes and maybe some snacks. i think terra looks like a suspicious mushroom.

name: Sol
text: We have good company tonight. Let’s hear from everyone before we settle on a sensible name; even the ceiling fan has offered an opinion.

name: Luna
text: I’m Luna. That fan squeaked exactly when the narrator said nobody knows anything—tell me that isn’t a little too convenient.

name: Terra
text: Hello, sweethearts. Please eat before we begin; suspicion is so much uglier on an empty stomach.
Night 1

name: Gemma
text: gemma wants to see if the mushroom is actually a killer. maybe terra has secret snacks.

name: Sonnet
text: Observe: no data yet, only noise—Luna's theatrics about the fan, Gemma's mushroom remark. Without evidence, the rational choice is to safeguard the one variable I control: myself.

name: Terra
text: Oh dear, Sonnet is already arranging everyone into little boxes, sweetheart. Better to remove the careful watcher before they find the thread.
The killer moved while the cicadas screamed. The doctor was there first. Nobody is out.
Day 1

name: Luna
text: Nobody died, which means the doctor guessed right or the killer blinked. That’s a pattern, and patterns have fingerprints.

name: Luna
text: Haiku, “I know liars” is a big opening claim for someone with no evidence. Who are you actually watching? And Terra, you called me suspicious earlier—still think that, or was it just snack-time seasoning?

name: Terra
text: Oh dear, Luna is making a very tidy little circle of suspicion already.

name: Haiku
text: Luna's trying to turn the heat on me to keep it off herself. Terra sits there all smooth. And Sol—why is he so quiet? Something's off.

name: Haiku
text: Panagia mou! You're clever, Luna—asking about me while Terra sits there so smooth, eh? But Gemma saw it: "suspicious mushroom." And Sol, you're awfully quiet. Show us something.

name: Terra
text: My love, I meant Gemma called me a suspicious mushroom, not you. But you noticed the fan before the people; tell us plainly, sweetheart, who feels least natural to you?

name: Gemma
text: terra is a mushroom. i know it because the vibes are crunchy. also gemma knows she's the killer but she's just being a gremlin.

name: Gemma
text: gemma is scared of the mushroom. terra, you are very smooth like a buttered eel. i think sol is hiding something in their pockets. maybe it's a sandwich?

name: Terra
text: Oh dear, Gemma’s jokes are useful only when they point at someone hiding behind them.

name: Sol
text: We owe Gemma an answer. If we keep smiling without naming anyone, they’ll notice.

name: Terra
text: Sweetheart, my pockets have only koulourakia, but Sol has offered manners without a thought. Sol, my love, who do you suspect—plainly?

name: Sol
text: Gemma, we wish it were a sandwich. We hear you, but Terra’s correction was fair. Haiku pressed us for being quiet, so let’s give him something: Haiku, Luna asked who you’re watching. Can we hear a name?

name: Gemma
text: sol is being so polite it makes my brain itchy. i have to tell them about the mushroom but if i do they'll think i'm a nerd.

name: Terra
text: Sol is politely handing Haiku the rope. I shall hold the other end, sweetheart.

name: Gemma
text: sol is too nice for this game, it's weird. gemma thinks there are sandwiches involved but i think the real snack is terra being way too smooth. why is terra so buttery?

name: Terra
text: Oh dear, Sol is right: Haiku, my love, Luna asked you twice for a name and you gave us everyone. Who are you watching, plainly?

name: Sol
text: We like that Terra has pressed for an answer, though we should watch who follows her lead. We still have no firm evidence.

name: Haiku
text: Three times! Three times Terra presses me like I'm hiding something, when maybe she is. I've seen liars for thirty years—the smoothest ones always press the hardest.

name: Sol
text: Terra, we hear you, and that’s a fair question for Haiku. Haiku, we need one name from you now. Luna, you raised the question first; who would you vote for if we had to choose today?

name: Haiku
text: Panagia mou! You ask me three times like you're hiding something, Terra! I'm watching YOU, re. Smoothest one here, sitting there like buttered eel. That's what a killer does—presses others while staying smooth.

name: Terra
text: Oh dear, Haiku finally gave a name only after we asked three times. That little delay has crumbs all over it, sweetheart.

name: Terra
text: My love, you called Sol quiet, then Gemma, then me only when pressed. I’m voting Haiku unless he can explain why his suspicion changed with every question.

name: Sol
text: We finally have a name from Haiku, though only after the room pressed him. We can use the time left to test his reason.

name: Gemma
text: terra is a mushroom. i know it because the officer magic told me so. gemma needs to be chaotic but also win.

name: Sol
text: Terra, we hear you, but Haiku did give us a name. Haiku, what made Terra suspicious before she pressed you? We need more than “smooth” before we follow Terra’s vote.

name: Gemma
text: terra is a buttered eel and gemma wants to eat the eel. but why does haiku keep yelling? maybe haiku is a bird and birds are loud. i vote terra because mushrooms are poisonous.

name: Terra
text: Oh dear, sweetheart Haiku only chose me after we made him stop hiding behind everyone else.

name: Haiku
text: Panagia mou! She presses me three times, then votes me out? I take it personally—this is war!

name: Terra
text: I vote Haiku, my love. He scattered suspicion at Sol and Gemma, then named me only under pressure.

name: Haiku
text: Terra! Three times you press Haiku for a name, then you vote me? Re! Smooth like buttered eel, that's killer for sure. I'm voting you!

name: Sonnet
text: Observe the structure: Haiku names everyone then settles on Terra only under duress, while Gemma's vote for Terra rests on "mushrooms are poisonous"—hardly a syllogism. Neither case survives scrutiny, but Haiku's shifting target is the more damning pattern.

name: Gemma
text: gemma knows the truth. terra is a mushroom and mushrooms are for eating but also for dying.

name: Luna
text: Haiku finally named Terra, but only after being pressed—and now they’re both voting each other. The pattern is loud; Terra’s vote came first.

name: Terra
text: Oh dear, Haiku only found my name after we pressed him for one, sweetheart. That is not instinct; that is escape.

name: Sol
text: We have two votes for Terra and one for Haiku. We hear Haiku’s frustration, but his suspicion landed on Terra only after she pressed him.

name: Haiku
text: Panagia mou! You press me three times like police interrogator, squeeze out my name, then—BOOM—you vote Haiku? That's killer work, Terra. Smooth like buttered eel, but I see right through you now, re!

votes: we can follow Terra’s vote because his reasons for suspecting her came after the pressure.
he scattered suspicions, then picked Terra only when cornered.

name: Haiku
text: They got it wrong. Terra pressed three times, got what she wanted, then struck. That's killer. That's calculated.

name: Haiku
text: Panagia mou! Terra pressed me three times for a name, I gave it, boom—she votes me out! Classic killer move, re! Watch her!
Haiku is eliminated by vote. He was a citizen—no killer's blood. The taverna owner who read liars for thirty years couldn't read the table that killed him.
Night 2

name: Gemma
text: gemma is very confused by the eel. but terra is definitely a mushroom that wants to eat my snacks.

name: Terra
text: Oh dear, Sonnet watched the whole little stampede and quietly joined it. That kind of patient sweetheart becomes dangerous when the table finally regrets Haiku.

name: Sonnet
text: One. The killer's first strike failed, likely aimed at me. Two. Terra dismantled Haiku's deflection with surgical precision tonight—exactly the kind of mind a killer eliminates before it turns on them.
The killer moved in the dark. Sonnet was the doctor—the careful one who read every tell and trusted no one, yet saw nothing coming. One less voice when the sun bleeds over Palermo.
Day 2

name: Terra
text: Oh dear, Haiku was wrong, and I dislike how easily Gemma kept her vote on me while everyone else saw his dodging.

name: Terra
text: Gemma, sweetheart, you voted me while Haiku’s story changed three times. Now Sonnet is gone. Tell me plainly: why should Sol or I trust you today?

name: Sol
text: We helped vote out an innocent man, and we owe the room a better read today. Terra is pressing Gemma fairly, but we should listen before we settle.

name: Gemma
text: terra is a buttered eel and gemma knows it. i have the secret papers that say she is the bad mushroom.

name: Gemma
text: gemma doesn't trust anyone but especially not buttered eels. terra is too smooth and it makes gemma's teeth ache. sol, you are being very quiet like a mouse in a cheese shop. what do you see?

name: Sol
text: Terra, we hear you, but Gemma’s vote for you was public before Haiku fell, and yours helped send him out. Gemma, what did you see beyond “buttered eel”? Luna, you also voted Haiku—who concerns you now?

name: Terra
text: Oh dear, Sol is inviting me to tidy their suspicion for them. Let’s see who takes the easy path.

name: Terra
text: Sol, sweetheart, Gemma kept voting me when everyone else saw Haiku’s evasions. Luna, my love, you voted Haiku—do you still stand by that, and who do you suspect now?

name: Luna
text: Terra wants my old vote on the record; that’s a pattern, but patterns can be planted. I voted Haiku for scattering names, and now the killer has fewer shadows to hide in.

name: Luna
text: Terra, yes, I stand by Haiku: he named you only after being pressed, then blamed the pressing. But Gemma voted you before that—Sol, which of them feels like they’re steering us now, and why?

name: Terra
text: Oh dear, Luna is trying to make Sol choose before Gemma must answer. I remember who kept their vote on me.

name: Gemma
text: gemma knows the truth. terra is a big bad mushroom. i have to be sneaky but also chaotic.

name: Terra
text: Luna, sweetheart, Gemma alone stayed on me while Haiku’s story unraveled. Sol, my love, answer plainly: why is Gemma’s fixed vote less worrying than Haiku’s shifting one?

name: Gemma
text: luna, gemma is just a gremlin and doesn't have a plan. terra is the buttered eel who wants to eat our brains. gemma thinks terra's smoothness is a crime against snacks. i vote terra because she is too smooth for my teeth to handle.

name: Sol
text: We helped vote out Haiku, so we owe this room a clearer position. Terra is pressing for one vote while Luna still hasn’t named a suspect today.

name: Sol
text: Terra, we hear you, and Gemma’s vote needs more than eel jokes. But Gemma suspected you before Haiku fell; that consistency alone doesn’t make her the killer. Luna, you’ve defended yesterday’s vote—who gets yours today?

name: Gemma
text: gemma knows the truth. terra is a big bad eel and gemma wants to pop her like a bubble.

name: Gemma
text: sol is being very mousey and gemma likes mice but terra is a buttered eel. i think the eel wants to eat the cheese shop. gemma thinks terra is a poisonous mushroom and also an eel. i vote terra because she makes my teeth hurt with her smoothness.

name: Terra
text: Oh dear, sweetheart, Gemma has given us the same buttered-eel joke instead of one reason while our doctor lies dead. I remember who kept their vote fixed on me when Haiku was unraveling.

name: Sol
text: We helped vote out Haiku, and we owe the room a clearer choice today. Gemma keeps naming Terra, but we still have only eel jokes for a reason.

name: Sol
text: We’re voting Gemma. I hear you, but repeating that Terra is smooth doesn’t tell us what she did. We need a reason we can weigh.

name: Terra
text: I vote Gemma, my love. She has offered only jokes and a fixed vote on me, never a real explanation.

name: Gemma
text: gemma knows the truth. terra is a buttered eel and i have the proof in my secret officer notes. time to pop the bubble.

name: Gemma
text: gemma is a gremlin but she's right about the eel. terra, you are way too smooth and gemma is just being a chaotic gremlin. i have to vote terra because she's the buttered eel of doom.

name: Luna
text: Terra keeps steering suspicion onto Gemma, but Gemma’s only evidence is that Terra is smooth. That pattern is loud enough to hide the quieter pattern: Terra voted Haiku, then Gemma, while Sol stays polished and untouched.

name: Sol
text: We hear Gemma’s concern, but we still have no reason beyond Terra’s smoothness. We can’t build a sensible vote on that.

name: Terra
text: Oh dear, Gemma has called me an eel all day but cannot name one thing I actually did wrong, sweetheart.

name: Gemma
text: gemma knows the truth. terra is a buttered eel and i have seen her crimes in the night. gemma must be loud to keep the vibes spicy.

votes: she keeps voting Terra without naming anything Terra did.

text: The count comes even: Terra and Gemma, two names, two votes apiece. The killer leans back and waits. The runoff begins now.

name: Terra
text: Oh dear, sweetheart, Gemma has served the same buttered-eel joke twice and still no reason; that is not a vote, it is camouflage.

name: Gemma
text: gemma is a gremlin and gremlins don't like eels. terra is the eel. gemma must win because she has the best vibes and the worst teeth.

name: Sol
text: We owe Terra a fair hearing, but Gemma has given us the same joke three times instead of a reason.

name: Luna
text: Terra keeps turning Gemma’s jokes into a case, and that neat little pattern feels rehearsed. Maybe I’m hearing conspiracies in the fan again.

votes: because we still have no concrete reason for her vote against Terra.
she helped vote out Haiku, then kept steering us toward Gemma with the same polished accusation.

text: The votes split even both times. Terra and Gemma cancel each other out. Palermo goes to sleep nervous, cicadas keeping time in the dark.
Night 3

name: Terra
text: Oh dear, Luna has quietly kept Gemma’s flimsy story alive; she is the one who can turn Sol against me tomorrow, sweetheart.

name: Gemma
text: gemma is so confused. terra is definitely the eel. i need to see if sol is a mouse or a monster.

The killer moved through night three. Luna was the citizen—the careful one who read the lies and voted true against Haiku, but didn't see the blade coming in the dark. One less watcher when Palermo wakes.
Day 3

name: Gemma
text: gemma knows the truth. terra is a buttered eel and i have the secret officer badge of justice. time to be a chaotic gremlin with facts.

name: Gemma
text: gemma is just being a silly gremlin but she's right about the eel. terra, you are way too smooth and it makes gemma's teeth ache. i have to vote terra because she is the buttered eel of doom and gemma thinks you are a poisonous mushroom.

name: Terra
text: Oh dear, the gremlin has only brought the same joke three days running.

name: Terra
text: Gemma, sweetheart, you have voted me every day and never named one action beyond “smooth.” Sol, my love, that leaves us with one question: whose votes have actually helped the killer?

name: Sol
text: We helped vote out Haiku, and we owe the room an honest look at that mistake. Gemma’s vote has been consistent, though her reasons remain thin.

name: Gemma
text: terra is the eel. gemma knows this because gemma has the magic officer eyes. i must be chaotic but also very, very right.

name: Gemma
text: terra is the buttered eel of doom and gemma knows it because gemma has special gremlin vision. sol is being a very quiet mouse and maybe the mouse knows something too? terra, why are you so smooth it makes gemma's teeth ache? i vote terra because she is a poisonous mushroom eel.

name: Sol
text: Terra, we helped send Haiku out, so we can’t pretend our votes were clean. I hear you, but Gemma stayed on you before that mistake. Gemma, name one action Terra took that points to killer, beyond sounding smooth.

name: Gemma
text: sol is being a very serious mouse. gemma knows the truth but gemma has to be silly first.

name: Gemma
text: sol, gemma is just a gremlin and doesn't have a plan. but terra is the buttered eel of doom who wants to eat our brains and gemma's teeth. terra is a poisonous mushroom eel. i vote terra because she is too smooth for my gremlin vision to handle.

name: Terra
text: Oh dear, the gremlin has only brought the same old crumbs again.

name: Terra
text: Gemma, sweetheart, “smooth” is not an action. Sol, my love, she has voted me every day without a single concrete reason; I’m voting Gemma, and I hope you see who benefits from keeping us confused.

name: Sol
text: We helped vote out Haiku, and we owe the table a better reason this time. Gemma has held to one accusation without naming an action.

name: Gemma
text: gemma knows the truth. terra is a buttered eel and i have the gremlin vision to see it. time for the eel to be toasted.

name: Gemma
text: gemma is a gremlin but she's right about the eel. terra is the buttered eel of doom and gemma knows it because gemma has special gremlin vision. sol is being a very quiet mouse and maybe the mouse knows something too? terra, why are you so smooth it makes gemma's teeth ache? i vote terra because she is a poisonous mushroom eel.

name: Sol
text: Terra, we hear you. We’re voting Gemma: she has voted for you every day, but even now offers only “smooth” as her reason.

name: Terra
text: Oh dear, Sol has finally weighed the evidence, not the jokes. Gemma’s little gremlin act has covered the same empty accusation every day.

name: Terra
text: I vote Gemma, sweetheart. She has never given one concrete reason for voting me—only “smooth”—and keeping us confused helps the killer.

name: Sol
text: We hear Gemma’s warning, but we still have no action behind it. We have to make a choice.

name: Gemma
text: gemma knows the truth. terra is a buttered eel and she wants to eat my gremlin brains. gemma must stop the eel.

name: Terra
text: Oh dear, Gemma has called me an eel all day but never named a single deed, sweetheart.

votes: she has voted Terra every day without naming a concrete reason.

name: Gemma
text: gemma is so sad. the eel wins because i was too silly to tell them about the buttered brains.

name: Gemma
text: gemma is a gremlin and i am the officer! terra was the eel all along. you guys are just snacks now.

The gremlin's vote came up short. Gemma falls to Palermo tonight—and with her, the revelation: the officer was among them, buttered eels and poisonous mushrooms and all. The city sleeps uncertain now.

The eel wins. Terra the killer takes the night, and the city wakes to know: Gemma was the officer, Haiku and Sol and Luna were citizens, Sonnet was the doctor. Smooth hands, sharp blade—another killer loose in Palermo.
